facts.fact: ARCEP's half-year 2026 observatory says Starlink CAR obtained a licence to market and operate satellite fixed wireless internet in CAF (licence date not given; document published 2026-09-16).

ARCEP reports Starlink CAR officially launched satellite fixed wireless internet to users in Bangui in March 2026 and held over 70% of the 5,380 fixed wireless internet clients at end-June 2026 (Orange 29%), carrying over 22.89 million GB of traffic since March.

note: ARCEP gives no satellite-only subscriber count (5,380 is all fixed wireless, Orange included), so no counted fact.
